title: Nice heavy cast iron skillet
text: Nice heavy cast iron skillet. This skillet is nice and heavy. You can't go wrong with cast iron.  I didn't look at the box to see where it's manufactured.

product_metadata.title: Rachael Ray Premium Rust-Resistant Cast Iron Frying Pan/Skillet with Helper Handle and Pour Spouts, 12 Inch, Agave Blue
features: WHAT YOU GET: The new 12-inch Premium RUST-RESISTANT Cast Iron Skillet from Rachael Ray. Easy to use, easy to clean, and it comes with a convenient helper handle and pour spouts, too.
PERFORMANCE & DESIGN: Nitro heat treatment combines the performance of a pre-seasoned cast iron fry pan with the gorgeous color of enameled cast iron.
EASY TO MAINTAIN: Nitro technology seals and smooths for a more rust-resistant cast iron surface that's easier to maintain. No need to pre-season.
WASH IT, SCRUB IT, CRANK IT UP: Discover why the nitro heat technology makes for incredibly easy-to-use cast iron and great looking, long lasting performance.
STOVE TO OVEN TO TABLE: Cast iron skillet delivers versatility up to 500°F for smart, simple, stylish presentations
description: Get incredible cast iron performance that's easy to maintain with this Rachael Ray Premium RUST-RESISTANT™ Cast Iron Skillet that delivers the classic durability and performance of cast iron without the hassle of complicated cleaning. A nitro heat treatment seals and smooths surfaces for amazing, easy-to-use, easy-to-clean cast iron fortified to resist rusting, chipping, and staining. Wash it, scrub it, crank it up on the stovetop or in the oven! The nitro heat treatment seals and smooths surfaces for cast iron that is truly built to last for generations to come. This extra roomy 12-inch cast iron frying pan features a helper handle for all of your stove-to-oven recipes and built-in spouts for easy pouring, and the satiny-smooth nitro finish holds brilliant colors to complement any kitchen. Induction capable and made to last a lifetime (and look great for a lifetime, too), this durable meal maker is pre-seasoned and ready to deliver. See why cast iron is one of Rachael's favorite ways to make meals even more delish.

details.Special Feature: Gas Stovetop Compatible, Electric Stovetop Compatible, Induction Stovetop Compatible
